data.narrative:
Reflection AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable set of 9 private and 1 public company in the AI & Software sector, with particular focus on 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers: Scale AI ($29.0B Series B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B).

The stage-progression method is inapplicable here. The target's stated post-money valuation of $25.0B, when applied against a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression, yields an implied $50.0B valuation. This figure exceeds 20x the company's $2.0B in total raised capital, suggesting the input valuation is unreliable and likely reflects a data-parsing error. Consequently, peer-median triangulation provides the primary anchor. The three comparable companies yield a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $29.0B.

The analysis supports a fair value estimate of $5.6B (median), with a reasonable band of $4.8B (low) to $6.4B (high). Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peers—Scale AI at $29.0B materially exceeds the group median—and the stage mismatch between this Series A target and predominantly Series B comparables. Materiality of the $25.0B claim warrants direct verification against capital table records before use in negotiations.
